blocks.raw: > Using Akamai's CloudTest to optimize your approach to load testing with a scalable, global platform. CloudTest provides testing capabilities for web and mobile apps, APIs, databases, and web services. Realtime analytics and customizable dashboards provide actionable intelligence, allowing for root-cause analysis while tests run.
